titre: Mandatory vaccinations and check-ups at the PMI
resume: Vaccines required for daycare, school and the holiday club according to the year of birth, including meningococcus A, B, C, W and Y, and check-ups for children under 6 at the PMI (mother and child health service).
aQuoiCaSert: Unless there is a medical contraindication, mandatory vaccinations are required to enter daycare, school, childcare or a holiday camp: without proof, enrollment may only be provisional, then refused. The proof is the health record book (carnet de santé) filled in by the doctor. Mother and child health centers (protection maternelle et infantile, PMI), run by the conseil départemental (département council), offer free consultations for pregnant women and children under 6.
quiEstConcerne: All parents of minor children, especially before starting daycare, school, childcare or a holiday camp.
Parents of children under 6, for consultations and vaccinations at the PMI.
aSavoir: Child born before 2018: only the primary vaccination against diphtheria, tetanus and polio (DTP) is required for school.
Child born between 2018 and 2022: 11 mandatory vaccines (diphtheria, tetanus, polio, whooping cough, Haemophilus influenzae b, hepatitis B, pneumococcus, meningococcus C, measles, mumps, rubella).
Child born from 2023: same list, but the meningococcal vaccination covers serogroups A, B, C, W and Y (and no longer C only).

A child who is not up to date can be admitted provisionally: you have 3 months to catch up on the vaccines, otherwise the facility can exclude the child. If the child is admitted for more than a year, proof is requested every year.

20 mandatory health check-ups from birth to age 16, including 16 before age 6. They are reimbursed at 100% with no upfront payment, except extra fees (dépassements d'honoraires). Until age 6, they can be done by the regular doctor, another doctor or the PMI.
Separated parents: the parent who takes the child to be vaccinated should inform the other and send them a copy of the vaccination pages, so that each has the proof.

documents.detail: Original. If another person accompanies the child, bring written authorization from a parent.

With your regular doctor or pediatrician, or at a PMI center in your département for children under 6. Call ahead to find out the consultation days.
Health record book, carte Vitale or certificate of entitlement, ID, written authorization if the accompanying adult is not a parent.
The health professional records the vaccine in the health record book.
A photocopy of the vaccination pages to the daycare, school or holiday club, every year if the child stays more than a year.
